approximate_ldo_loop_ac_boundary.finding: The previous helper enumerated descending0dB crossings only. All six r10 curves also cross upward near8.83-10.45MHz; capacitive input loading can create this term without an active feedback return loop. The saved voltage ratio is not a verified return ratio.
approximate_ldo_loop_ac_boundary.conclusion: Do not interpret first180+phase numbers as established phase margin or stability proof. This does not by itself prove high-frequency oscillation. r10 support is limited to the completed finite time-domain cases; full1Hz-1GHz complex data remain retained.

schema_notes: Frames retain each immutable raw result and analysis hash. explicit_capacitor_energy adds only sums and payload-normalized deltaU from recorded native endpoints; full startup/run energy remains separate. Failed and unfinished executions are never counted as passed.
